fields.description: Golf Edge brings one to three bedroom apartments and a small collection of three bedroom townhouses to Emaar South. Its understated architecture pairs earthy colours with natural materials. Outdoor spaces focus on the pool, landscaped lawns and places to exercise, with the wider golf community forming the setting.

reviewCoverage.identity: Golf Edge distinguished from Golf Acres, Golf Point and later Emaar South launches; official project page and own named documents reviewed.
reviewCoverage.location: Emaar South within canonical Dubai South. Official brochure context used; contradictory Dubai–Al Ain Road marketing line omitted.
reviewCoverage.residences: One to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses, with separate type rows.
reviewCoverage.areas: All 18 plan pages reviewed; image-only page 18 visually read. Plan totals include balcony/terrace. Launch sheet’s apartment maximum incorrectly includes townhouse-sized area; exact plan ranges used.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Official project facilities distinguished from wider Emaar South golf, retail and community-park offerings.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Official advertised AED 1,170,000 retained. Historical type prices attributed to launch sheet; no stock claim.
reviewCoverage.payment: Launch fact sheet read and visually checked: nine stages total 100%. PF corroborates 10/70/20. Alternative broker dates disclosed rather than merged.
reviewCoverage.handover: February 2029 in launch sheet and PF, shown as reported Q1 2029 target.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 19-page brochure; developer-branded 18-page plans hosted by Madena; accessible one-page launch sheet hosted by Dubai Listing. Broken older plan links rejected. No imagery changed.

overview: The brochure places the pool and outdoor leisure areas around a raised podium, with landscaped lawns and exercise spaces complementing the homes. Emaar South’s golf course, clubhouse, retail and community-park proposals provide the wider neighbourhood context. Access conditions and opening dates for these facilities need separate confirmation.
research.locationNote: Golf Edge is in Emaar South, within Dubai South and near Al Maktoum International Airport. The brochure maps it within this southern Dubai community. Specific commuting times should be checked for the intended route and time of day.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises a starting price of AED 1,170,000. This is a project headline, not confirmation of an available home at that price. Request the chosen unit’s current quotation and applicable charges.
research.paymentNote: The table reproduces the January 2025 launch schedule. GCC Offplan publishes different early dates: April 2025, September 2025 and February 2026. Both versions retain an 80/20 split; neither establishes the terms of a new booking.
research.handoverNote: The launch sheet targets February 2029 for construction completion, also reported by Property Finder. The contractual handover and current progress require confirmation.

facts.label: Launch composition
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 95 one bedroom, 58 two bedroom and 26 three bedroom apartments, plus five townhouses: 184 homes at launch, not current availability.

facts.label: Historical type prices
facts.value: Launch prices began at AED 1.17 million, 1.73 million and 2.50 million for one, two and three bedroom apartments; three bedroom townhouses started at AED 4.75 million.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The two-level plans show living, kitchen, maid’s room, laundry and store at the lower level, with three bedrooms upstairs. Total area includes terraces and balconies; it is not internal living area alone.

facts.label: Building arrangement
facts.value: The plan key section identifies ground and podium levels below 12 residential floors. The townhouse plans occupy ground and podium levels.
